prune.title: Clean up
prune.hint: Removes leftovers only. Volumes are never touched, and anything labelled armadok.protect=true is kept.
prune.confirm.containers: Stopped containers will be removed for good (their writable layer is lost).
prune.confirm.images: Images with no name and no container will be removed.
prune.confirm.networks: Networks with no container attached will be removed. The network of a stopped container is kept.
live.tip: Measures CPU and memory every few seconds. It puts a little load on the machine, so it is off by default.
stopConfirm: Stop {{name}}? What it serves will be unavailable until it starts again.
actionTip.stop: Stops the container (it can be started again)
actionTip.remove: Deletes the container itself, not its volumes
actionTip.logs: Shows the last 200 lines of its output
prune.tip.networks: Removes networks nothing is connected to
